title: 任务检视台
description: 以卡密管理等当前任务为中心，右侧检视抽屉提供单条记录上下文，顶部状态带压缩成运行摘要。
prompt: Wide desktop operations control tower with a vertical command spine, compact top status ribbon, oversized central single-line license table and a subordinate right inspector drawer showing selected license details and safe actions; dark graphite, cyan current state, mint and amber statuses, Chinese admin content, visible horizontal-scroll affordance, no marketing hero.
